findings.required_correction: Validate the prepare summary and fixture manifest against exact regular-file paths, reparse status, byte length, and SHA256 before launch; recheck actual compile-source hashes in Tcl before adding and launching.
findings.finding: PowerShell did not enforce the prepared source SHA/size bindings for all T57 sources and actual compile inputs before starting Vivado; compile-source hash verification was not a complete prelaunch gate.

findings.required_correction: Keep stage_status at simulation-flow PASS with data verification pending; after archiving evidence run the exact bound runner --verify-only and expose overall PASS only when its actual exit code is zero and its data report passes raw/INT8/D2 checks.
findings.finding: Simulation-flow completion could be interpreted as data acceptance without an automatic invocation of the same bound Python runner verification.

limitations: The original R8 reviewer report was not found among run08 files; this record preserves the findings supplied by the root task card and is not a verbatim reviewer transcript.
No Vivado/XSim was started for R9 preparation or static tests.
